meaning: restricted in ability to manoeuvre — keep clear
line: Vessel showing red-over-white-over-red: restricted in ability to manoeuvre — keep clear

meaning: constrained by draught — avoid impeding safe passage
line: Vessel showing red-over-red-over-red: constrained by draught — avoid impeding safe passage
Vessel showing red-over-red: not under command — keep clear
Vessel showing green-over-white: engaged in trawling
Vessel showing red-over-white: fishing other than trawling
Vessel showing white-over-red: pilot vessel on duty

meaning: possible towing vessel, tow exceeds 200 m; verify towing lights and aspect
line: Vessel showing white-over-white-over-white: possible towing vessel, tow exceeds 200 m; verify towing lights and aspect

meaning: ambiguous: towing (vertical whites) or power-driven vessel 50 m or longer (forward/aft mastheads); geometry alone is insufficient
line: Vessel showing white + white: ambiguous: towing (vertical whites) or power-driven vessel 50 m or longer (forward/aft mastheads); geometry alone is insufficient

meaning: both sidelights visible: approximately head-on; confirm risk and vessel type
line: Vessel showing red + green: both sidelights visible: approximately head-on; confirm risk and vessel type

meaning: her port side visible, likely crossing right to left; light alone does not establish right of way
line: Vessel showing red: her port side visible, likely crossing right to left; light alone does not establish right of way

meaning: her starboard side visible, likely crossing left to right; light alone does not establish right of way
line: Vessel showing green: her starboard side visible, likely crossing left to right; light alone does not establish right of way

meaning: ambiguous white light: stern, anchored vessel, or small power vessel; do not infer motion
line: Vessel showing white: ambiguous white light: stern, anchored vessel, or small power vessel; do not infer motion

meaning: possible air-cushion vessel in non-displacement mode; verify other lights
line: Vessel showing yellow: possible air-cushion vessel in non-displacement mode; verify other lights

meaning: possible law enforcement where locally authorized; flashing blue is not a universal COLREGS signal
line: Vessel showing blue: possible law enforcement where locally authorized; flashing blue is not a universal COLREGS signal

meaning: red flare reported: distress — render assistance as safe
line: Vessel showing red flares: red flare reported: distress — render assistance as safe

meaning: SOS reported by flashing light: distress — render assistance as safe
line: Vessel showing SOS: SOS reported by flashing light: distress — render assistance as safe
